description: Netwroxia Beacon Heartbeat Schema. Defines the packet structure, InfluxDB layout, status thresholds, and baseline parameters for the router-to-HO heartbeat system.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence counter per source router. Increments by 1 each cycle. Gaps indicate missed beacons.

rtt_ms.description: Average round-trip time in milliseconds across ping_count probes.

rtt_min_ms.description: Minimum RTT observed in this cycle.

rtt_max_ms.description: Maximum RTT observed in this cycle.

loss_pct.description: Packet loss percentage (0.0 to 100.0) across ping_count probes.

baseline_rtt_ms.description: Rolling baseline RTT for this router at time of write. Populated by baseline_engine.py; 0.0 on first cycle.

deviation_pct.description: Percent deviation of current RTT from baseline. Formula: ((rtt_ms - baseline_rtt_ms) / baseline_rtt_ms) * 100. 0.0 if no baseline yet.

src_router.description: Name of the router sending the beacon. One of: ZO-Bengaluru, BR-Koramangala, BR-Whitefield.

dst_router.description: Name of the beacon receiver. Always HO-Chennai for this topology.

OK.description: RTT within 1.5x baseline AND loss <= 1%. Healthy path.

DEGRADED.description: RTT between 1.5x and 3.0x baseline OR loss between 1% and 10%. Elevated risk.

CRITICAL.description: RTT between 3.0x and 10.0x baseline OR loss between 10% and 50%. Impending failure.

MISSING.description: 100% loss OR no beacon received within 3x collection interval. Path down.

baseline.description: Baseline uses a 60-minute rolling window. If fewer than 30 samples exist, fallback_rtt_ms is used. Baselines recomputed every 60 seconds by baseline_engine.py.

collection.description: Each router is probed every 10 seconds with 3 ICMP packets and a 5-second timeout. If 3 consecutive cycles return no response, status becomes MISSING.

notes: The 'container' field in routers[] must be verified against topology.yml before A2 is written.
The 'loopback' field is used as the ping target from the source router's container to HO-Chennai.
sequence_file '.beacon_seq.json' is a hidden state file tracking last seq per router to detect gaps.
All timestamps written to InfluxDB are UTC nanoseconds (InfluxDB 1.8 default).
